1.0.0: Initial release: companies, contacts, opportunities and orders, tasks (phone calls and to-dos), appointments, products, comments, users, order stages, polling triggers and Make API Call.
Support tickets (Customer Support product): Get Ticket, Find Tickets, Create Ticket, Update Ticket (including custom fields), Delete Ticket, Add Ticket Comment and the Updated Ticket trigger.
Updated Task trigger, e.g. for a follow-up task closed by its owner.
The Updated Company, Contact, Order, Task and Ticket triggers emit the changed fields and their previous values, and can fire only when a chosen field changes (optionally to a chosen value).
Create Task and Update Task accept activity custom field values.
